raw_text: Two Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy warships including a Type 054A guided-missile frigate arrived at the Chinese-built Hambantota International Port on Wednesday for a five-day goodwill visit. Sri Lanka Navy spokesman said the visit was part of normal diplomatic exchanges between the two navies. However, Indian officials privately expressed concern about the increasing frequency of Chinese naval visits to Hambantota, which is operated by China Merchants Port Holdings on a 99-year lease.
clean_text: Two PLAN warships including Type 054A arrived at Hambantota for five-day visit. India privately concerned about increasing frequency of Chinese naval visits to Chinese-operated port.
